validate_value_against_spec: validate a numpy array value against a dm_env BoundedArray spec with dtype and range checks
validate_observation_dict: validate an observation dictionary against its spec allowing missing keys but rejecting extra keys
cast_value_to_spec_dtype: cast a numpy array or scalar to the dtype defined by a dm_env Array spec
merge_bounded_array_specs: merge multiple BoundedArray specs into one by concatenating shapes, minimums, and maximums
shrink_to_fit_bounded_spec: shrink out-of-bounds values proportionally to fit within a BoundedArray spec minimum and maximum
